name: Hyderabad
description: The City of Pearls, famous for Nizami heritage, historic architecture, Biryani cuisine, Charminar, Golconda Fort, and vibrant IT culture.

name: New Delhi
description: Capital city rich in Mughal and colonial monuments, bustling markets, diverse street food, Red Fort, Qutub Minar, and political landmarks.

name: Goa
description: Coastal paradise world-renowned for golden beaches, Portuguese colonial churches, water sports, nightlife, and tropical coastal cuisine.

name: Jaipur
description: The Pink City of royalty, featuring Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, traditional Rajasthani cuisine, and block-print handicrafts.

name: Mumbai
description: The financial capital and City of Dreams, featuring Gateway of India, Marine Drive, Bollywood culture, street food, and Victorian Gothic architecture.

name: Bengaluru
description: The Garden City and Silicon Valley of India, known for pleasant climate, Lalbagh Botanical Garden, craft breweries, and tech innovation.

name: Varanasi
description: One of the world's oldest living spiritual cities on the Ganges river, famous for evening Ganga Aarti, ghats, ancient temples, and silk weaving.

name: Agra
description: Home to the world wonder Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, Fatehpur Sikri, and rich Mughal history, marble inlay art, and petha sweets.

name: Kochi
description: Historic port city known as Queen of the Arabian Sea, featuring Chinese fishing nets, Fort Kochi, spice markets, Kathakali art, and backwaters.

name: Kolkata
description: The Cultural Capital of India, renowned for Victoria Memorial, Howrah Bridge, colonial heritage, Bengali sweets, Durga Puja, and literature.

name: Chennai
description: Gateway to South India, renowned for Marina Beach, classical Carnatic music, Dravidian temples, Bharatanatyam dance, and filter coffee.

name: Udaipur
description: City of Lakes, featuring romantic Lake Pichola, City Palace, Jag Mandir, Rajput royal heritage, and sunset boat rides.

name: Amritsar
description: Spiritual center of Sikhism, famous for the magnificent Golden Temple, Wagah Border ceremony, Jallianwala Bagh, and Punjabi cuisine.

name: Manali
description: High-altitude Himalayan resort town known for snow peaks, Solang Valley adventures, Rohtang Pass, apple orchards, and trekking trails.

name: Mysuru
description: City of Palaces, famous for grand Mysore Palace, Dasara celebrations, sandalwood, silk sarees, and Chamundi Hills.

name: Rishikesh
description: Yoga Capital of the World along the holy Ganges, famous for river rafting, bungee jumping, ashrams, and Beatles Ashram.

name: Shimla
description: Queen of Hills and former British summer capital, featuring Mall Road, Christ Church, toy train, and pine-covered Himalayan hills.
best_season: March to June, Dec to Jan

name: Pondicherry
description: French colonial coastal town featuring French Quarter, promenade beach, Auroville, Mediterranean cafes, and tranquil atmosphere.

name: Darjeeling
description: Himalayan hill station famed for world-class Darjeeling tea, Kanchenjunga mountain views, Himalayan Railway toy train, and monasteries.
best_season: March to May, Oct to Dec

name: Pune
description: Cultural capital of Maharashtra, featuring Aga Khan Palace, Shaniwar Wada, youth culture, hill getaways, and Maharashtrian cuisine.
